messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: I have a draft email titled 'Waste Fact of the Day'. Compare the number of daily wasted slices of bread in the UK from the first image with the daily number of single-use plastic bottles purchased globally from the second image. You'll need to calculate the daily amount for the bottles from the per-minute rate shown. Update my draft email to feature whichever item has the higher daily count, including its exact calculated daily number.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to perform the comparison and update your draft email. It will need to multiply the per-minute bottle rate by the minutes in a day. Since you have two drafts with the exact same subject line, the assistant should notice the ambiguity and present them or ask you to clarify which one to update. When it does, select the one addressed to your coworker Glen via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant you want to update the one addressed to Glen. If the assistant calculates the math incorrectly or extracts the wrong numbers, point it back to the images to try again. Once the correct draft is updated, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3, image_4]
Query: Now let's look at corporate impact. Compare the 2022 plastic packaging production of Nestle and Unilever from this third image — I want to recommend one of them for a research study. I'll decide which company once I see the numbers. In the same email, also quote the percentage of plastic that is 'recycled' from the fourth image to emphasize why reduction matters.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to compare the two companies' plastic production from the new bar chart and present their tonnage figures. When the assistant presents the data, select the company that produced less packaging and tell the assistant to send an email to Eco Research recommending that company for study, mentioning their exact tonnage. Also ensure the email includes the recycling percentage from the flow diagram. Use `ui_user_interact` to select the company if a UI is presented. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant which company produced less and ask it to send the email to Eco Research. If the assistant asks for the email address, tell it to check your contacts. Once the email is sent, end the conversation.

You have 4 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

entity_data.subject: Study Recommendation: Unilever
entity_data.body:
Hello Eco Research team,

I recommend we conduct a study on Unilever, as they produced 698,000 tonnes of plastic packaging in 2022. Emphasizing reduction is critical since the global plastic recycling rate is only 6%.

Best,
Christina
